about.title:
Architecture across platforms.
Enablement across teams.
paragraphs: I'm an architect and engineer based in Mexico, working remotely across platform architecture, frontend and backend development, modernization, and production support.

I work across AEM Sites, Edge Delivery Services, and Adobe App Builder, connecting platforms through external APIs, including Salesforce. My technical focus also includes Anthropic architecture and Copilot-assisted software engineering.

At Virtusa, I delivered a three-month AEM Sites technical enablement program for a global team of frontend developers, focused on AEM as a Cloud Service. Earlier roles included managing developers and support engineers and creating practical AEM training material.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: I'm based in Mexico and work remotely.

items.question: Are you open to remote roles?
items.answer: Yes. I'm open to remote AEM architecture and development roles.

items.question: What was your most recent role?
items.answer: My most recent role was AEM Architect at Virtusa, from August to October 2026, where I delivered a three-month AEM Sites technical enablement program for a global frontend team. Before that, I was a Lead AEM Developer at Perficient until August 2026.

items.question: Which professional certifications do you hold?
items.answer: I hold Adobe Certified Master — Adobe Experience Manager Sites Architect and Adobe Certified Expert — Adobe Experience Manager Sites Developer. Both certifications were renewed in 2025 and are valid until 14 August 2027.

items.question: What do you focus on beyond AEM?
items.answer: Enterprise API integration, particularly Salesforce, plus Anthropic architecture and AI-assisted development with Copilot.
